editorial.meta_description: C_S4CS_2302 is retired by SAP with a price of 562.0 USD. Prepare for the C_S4CS successor exam covering SAP S/4HANA Cloud service processes.
editorial.overview: The SAP Certified Application Associate — SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition — Service exam is fully retired by SAP. This retired credential featured 80 total questions with an exam price of 562.0 USD and a required duration of 180 minutes. Candidates should look toward the direct successor exam path for their certification goals.
editorial.who_should_take: Consultants and implementation professionals seeking validation of cloud service expertise should register for the C_S4CS successor exam rather than attempting this retired credential, since registration for this older code is no longer available.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Focus your preparation entirely on mastering the core competencies outlined in the current certification objectives. Review official documentation on service processes, master data, warranty claims, and reporting to prepare effectively for the C_S4CS successor exam rather than studying the retired code to ensure you cover all necessary operational guidelines successfully.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers service order management principles, specific business processes, and vital monitoring tasks within the SAP S/4HANA Cloud environment to ensure operational excellence across enterprise systems and daily support operations.

This domain focuses on service contract management, including creation procedures, complex change processes, and recurring service setups designed to maintain long-term customer relationships and predictable revenue streams for businesses.

This domain addresses field service management operations and integration points with external dispatch and execution tools, facilitating seamless coordination between back-office planning and on-site technician activities for service teams.

This domain deals with installed base management, reference objects, and tracking customer equipment configurations to provide accurate historical data for all deployed machinery and service-relevant components across customer sites.

This domain pertains directly to warranty and claims management, handling customer and supplier warranty claim processing, verification procedures, and financial postings associated with defective part replacements and service guarantees.

This domain covers advanced analytics and reporting features used to monitor service performance, evaluate key figures, and generate actionable business insights through standard reporting applications and flexible analysis tools.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Because C_S4CS_2302 is retired, you cannot schedule it. Candidates must book and sit for the C_S4CS successor exam through Pearson VUE or online proctored testing.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The retired C_S4CS_2302 exam contained exactly 80 questions across multiple choice, multiple select, drag and drop, and matching formats within the total question pool provided by the system.
The passing score for the retired C_S4CS_2302 certification exam was 68 correct answers out of the total question pool required to successfully pass the evaluation process.
The allowed duration for completing the C_S4CS_2302 exam was 180 minutes, providing candidates enough time to answer all questions before final submission and scoring during the examination.

faq.question_title: What is the replacement exam for C_S4CS_2302?
faq.answer_text: SAP retired C_S4CS_2302 and established C_S4CS as the direct replacement path for candidates seeking current certification credentials in this domain of study to advance professional careers.
